title.narrative: Fostering Freedom of Expression and Safety of Journalists in South Sudan

description.narrative: South Sudan has taken steps to have legal frameworks works to promote freedom of expression and access to information as reflected under Articles 24 and 32 of the transitional national constitution 2011 and reflected in the media laws (Media Authority Act, 2013, Right to Access to Information Act 2013. In addition, the government has gone ahead to establish the relevant institutions to support implementation of the Laws. For efficient implementation of the Laws, its imperative that other stakeholders like security officers are empowered through training to understand the laws in place and role of journalists on South Sudan, with the purpose to foster/boost the promotion of FOE, access to information and safety of journalists. Development of a national platform/tool for recording and monitoring media incidences will enhance efforts on advocacy for safety of journalists and identity areas that require urgent support
